summary: Single-step torque-force product computation on a vehicle-dynamics object. Multiplies the double at this+0x36C by the double at this+0x364 to form v1, stores the product at this+0x374, then writes this+0x22C = v1 * (double at this+0x38C) + (double at this+0x384). No guards; always executes. Part of the vehicle dynamics force-accumulation path (both packet callers are force-accumulation functions).

local_names.this: vehicle-dynamics object whose force/torque members are combined

operations.description: v1 = *(double*)(this+0x36C) * *(double*)(this+0x364): multiply the multiplier input by the force input
*(double*)(this+0x374) = v1: store the intermediate torque-force product
*(double*)(this+0x22C) = v1 * *(double*)(this+0x38C) + *(double*)(this+0x384): scale the product by the additional factor and add the bias term into the accumulated torque output

unresolved: Physical meaning of each member (force input, multiplier, scaling factor, bias, outputs) is inferred from the existing fill analysis; the packet types no names
Both outputs this+0x22C and this+0x374 are recalulated every frame per the fill's persistence note, so external pokes do not persist
Owner class identity is not established by the packet
